# Self assessment 2024

My own return for tax year 2023/24 (6 Apr 2023 to 5 Apr 2024). UTR 73390 18462. Filing via FreeAgent as usual, not the HMRC portal.

**2024-04-08** Year closed. Pulled bank feeds. Turnover £71,940 (64 invoices), expenses £6,212. Told myself I'd file in May. Every year I tell myself that.

**2024-06-15** Gathered: P60 (none, no employment), Vanguard consolidated tax certificate, Chase interest £412.30, Starling interest £188.04, rental figures from the agent (Hollins Lettings statement HL-2324-031).

**2024-09-02** Rental side done, see [[Rental income tax]]. Profit £6,876 before the finance cost credit.

**2024-10-21** Pension higher-rate relief: £6,000 gross contributions to the SIPP. Box 1 of "Paying into registered pension schemes". Forgot this in 2022/23, amended on 3 Nov 2023 and got £1,040 back. Not forgetting again. Background in [[Pension consolidation]].

**2024-11-30** Gift Aid: £288.20 paid, entered as £288.20 (HMRC grosses up itself). Receipts filed in the charity folder.

**2025-01-11** Drafted. Tax + Class 4 NI: £14,882.60. Payments on account already made: £6,190 + £6,190. Balancing payment: £2,502.60. Plus first POA for 2024/25: £7,441.30. Total due 31 Jan: **£9,943.90**.

**2025-01-14** Checked the Class 2 NI line. Abolished as a charge from April 2024 but the 2023/24 year still credits it automatically above the small profits threshold, so no £179.40 bill this time. Good.

**2025-01-17** Submitted 21:47. Submission receipt IRmark ZK4P-7Q2M-91XB-HH03. Wrote about the relief of it in [[2025-01-17]].

**2025-01-31** Paid £9,943.90 by Faster Payments from the Starling tax space, reference 7339018462K. Gilt rung maturing the same day refilled the pot, see [[Tax deadline calendar]].
